# Mike's Travel Guide

> A comprehensive travel guide resource covering destinations across multiple continents with curated travel tips, bucket-list ideas, and adventure recommendations.

Mike's Travel Guide provides travel inspiration and practical guidance for destinations worldwide, including Portugal, North America, Central America, the Caribbean, and beyond. The site combines travel blogs, destination guides, and travel tips to help adventurers plan their next trip.
